leads.title: Pitcairn Islands Constitution Order 2010
leads.documents: Constitutional ban on discrimination based on sexual orientation; defines 'discriminatory' treatment
leads.detail: Quoted in article: affording different treatment on any ground such as sex, sexual orientation, race, colour, language, religion, etc. No URL or footnote visible in provided text.

leads.title: Same Sex Marriage and Civil Partnerships Ordinance 2015
leads.documents: Legalizes same-sex marriage from 14 May 2015; provides for recognition of registered civil partnership performed outside Pitcairn; includes provision that same-sex couples may be parents
leads.detail: Unanimously approved by Island Council 1 April 2015, signed by Governor Jonathan Sinclair 5 May, published 13 May 2015, effective 14 May 2015. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Marriage Ordinance - definition of marriage
leads.documents: Defines 'marriage' as union of two people regardless of their sex, sexual orientation or gender identity; one of only two mentions of gender identity in Pitcairn law
leads.detail: Direct quote visible in article text. No URL or footnote visible in provided text.

leads.title: Sentencing Ordinance
leads.documents: Requires courts to take into account if offence was committed on basis of victim's gender identity and sexual orientation when dealing with offender; hate-crime sentencing machinery
leads.detail: Described in Discrimination protections section. No URL or footnote visible in provided text.

leads.title: Adoption of Infants Ordinance
leads.documents: States married couples, unmarried couples and single people may jointly apply to adopt; combined with 2015 marriage law for same-sex parenting eligibility
leads.detail: Cited in Adoption and parenting section. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: 2006 UK Government Report on Pitcairn
leads.documents: Reports adoption practice context: 9 adoptions in Pitcairn since 1954, latest in 1979
leads.detail: Cited as 'According to a 2006 UK government report'. No report title or URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Judicature Ordinance 1961
leads.documents: Extended the law of England to Pitcairn; basis for homosexual activity being expressly illegal until 1967
leads.detail: Cited in Legality of same-sex sexual activity section. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Sexual Offences Act 1967
leads.documents: Decriminalization benchmark; homosexual activity expressly illegal in Pitcairn until passage of this Act
leads.detail: Cited as end of criminalization period. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Laws of Pitcairn 1893 and Laws of 1904 by R. T. Simons
leads.documents: 1893 Laws did not mention homosexuality; 1904 laws made it a crime for unmarried persons of either sex to congregate together causing scandal or endangering morals of younger members
leads.detail: Notes Pitcairn placed under jurisdiction of High Commissioner for Western Pacific in 1898. No URL visible in provided text.
